description_en: Queries online editing projects by creation time and status
description_zh: 支持按创建时间、状态搜索
kebab_example: aliyun ice search-editing-project --start-time 2017-01-11T12:00:00Z --end-time 2017-01-11T12:00:00Z --status Producing --sort-by CreationTime:Desc --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --create-source WebSDK --template-type Timeline --project-type EditingProject --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchEditingProject

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
parameters.help_zh: CreationTime（创建时间）的开始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
parameters.help_zh: CreationTime（创建时间）的结束时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The status of the online editing project. Separate multiple values with commas (,). By default, all online editing projects are queried.

Valid values:

-Draft

-Producing

-Produced

-ProduceFailed
parameters.help_zh:
云剪辑工程状态。多个用英文逗号（,）分隔。默认获取所有云剪辑工程。

取值范围：

-Draft：草稿。

-Producing：合成中。

-Produced：合成成功。

-ProduceFailed：合成失败
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The sorting rule of results. Valid values:

- CreationTime:Desc (default): The results are sorted in reverse chronological order based on the creation time.

- CreationTime:Asc: The results are sorted in chronological order based on the creation time
parameters.help_zh:
结果排序方式。取值范围：

-CreationTime:Desc（默认值）：按创建时间倒序。

-CreationTime:Asc：按创建时间升序
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，每页显示条数。默认值为10，最大值为100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The source of the project.

-OpenAPI

-AliyunConsole

-WebSDK

Valid values:

AliyunConsole: The project is created in the Alibaba Cloud console.

WebSDK: The project is created by using the SDK for Web.

OpenAPI: The project is created by calling API operations
parameters.name: create_source

parameters.help_en:
The template type. Valid values:

-Timeline

-VETemplate

Valid values:

Timeline: regular template.

VETemplate: advanced template.

None: No template is used
parameters.name: template_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the editing project. Default value: EditingProject. Valid values:

EditingProject: a regular editing project.

LiveEditingProject: a live stream editing project
parameters.help_zh:
剪辑工程类型，默认EditingProject

EditingProject: 普通剪辑工程

LiveEditingProject: 直播剪辑工程
parameters.name: project_type

MaxResults.description_en:
The maximum number of entries returned on a single page. The value is set to the maximum number of entries returned on each page except for the last page.

Examples:

Valid example: 10,10,5. Invalid example: 10,5,10
MaxResults.description_zh:
本次请求所返回的最大记录条数，最后一页前每页记录条数为MaxResults取值。

例如：

正例：10,10,5，反例：10,5,10

NextToken.description_en: A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If NextToken is empty, no next page exists
NextToken.description_zh: 用来表示当前调用返回读取到的位置，空代表数据已经读取完毕

BusinessConfig.description_en: The business configuration of the project. This parameter can be ignored for general editing projects
BusinessConfig.description_zh: 工程业务配置，一般剪辑工程可忽略

BusinessStatus.description_en:
The business status of the project. This parameter can be ignored for general editing projects. Valid values:

Valid values:

BroadCasting:

Reserving
